svg.text: THE CAVERN · PLOT PLAN 2 · 6 x 6 plots (252 x 252 m)
K The Cavern (dark, three tiers 4 / 8 / 12) · H Hollow Earth (open under the Inner Sun) · A Agartha (the crystal city, terraces 0 / 2 / 4). A number = the plot's level (1 = 1.75 m).
S = a stair between two levels · F = a waterfall (with a stair beside it) · pink = a way out of the zone
